items.title: OpenAI introduces Images 2.6
items.summary_en: OpenAI describes Images 2.6 as offering faster image generation, GIF creation, more precise editing and new API controls. It is available across ChatGPT, Codex and the API.

items.title: OpenAI publishes community compact and compute campus policy blueprint
items.summary_en: OpenAI published a National Community Compact covering its own data center campuses. It also published a Compute Campus Policy Blueprint proposing public reporting on water, energy, noise and hiring.

items.summary_en: OpenAI increased its bounty payouts. Critical findings in core products such as ChatGPT, Codex or the API Platform can now earn up to $30,000.
